description: Stability and Reliability Fixes - Prevent PeerJS session recreation on keystrokes, support Uint8Array binary chunks, and add file transfer unit tests

userStories.title: Stabilize PeerJS session lifecycle in SecureChat
userStories.description: As a user, I want chat and file transfers to remain connected while typing or receiving updates, so that my connection does not abruptly terminate.
acceptanceCriteria: Stabilize handleFileConnection and setupConn in src/SecureChat.jsx so they do not recreate and trigger useEffect cleanup on every render
Ensure Peer initialization runs once on mount and does not call peerInst.destroy() on input state updates
Add guard check for connRef.current before accessing connRef.current.peer in startOutboundFileTransfer

userStories.title: Support Uint8Array and ArrayBufferView for incoming file chunks
userStories.description: As a user, I want incoming file chunks deserialized as Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer to be accepted, so that file transfers do not fail with chunk validation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Update chunk type validation in src/SecureChat.jsx to accept both ArrayBuffer and ArrayBufferView (Uint8Array) for packet.iv and packet.ciphertext
Ensure buffer slicing or normalization passes valid BufferSource to decryptFileChunk

userStories.title: Add automated unit tests for fileTransfer.js
userStories.description: As a developer, I want comprehensive test coverage for fileTransfer.js, so that chunk encryption, decryption, AAD formatting, and transfer ID generation are verified in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/fileTransfer.test.js with test suites for encryptFileChunk, decryptFileChunk, fileAAD, and makeTransferId
Verify round-trip chunk encryption and decryption with authentic and tampered AAD
All tests pass via npm test (node --test src/*.test.js)
